description: Provisional synthetic coding-task labels. Review these labels before using them as an activation gate.

cases.task: Fix a typo in README.md with no source change.
Format the indentation in one JSON fixture without changing values.
Rename a misspelled local variable and update its two references.
Correct an outdated inline comment; behavior must remain unchanged.
Remove trailing whitespace from the configuration sample.
Change the CLI help label from 'Models' to 'Model'.
Rename one unit-test title so it describes the existing assertion.
Remove a single unused import reported by the linter.
Repair one broken relative link in the documentation.
Replace a duplicated literal with the existing constant in the same file.
Add a limited feature with unit tests in one subsystem.
Fix the parser bug that drops escaped commas and add a regression test.
Validate a new optional CLI flag and cover valid and invalid inputs.
Add one authenticated read-only endpoint using the existing service pattern.
Make the HTTP client expose its configured timeout and add unit coverage.
Diagnose and fix stale cache entries after a successful update.
Add loading and empty states to the existing results component.
Add structured error logging around the existing background job.
Support one new configuration field through parsing, validation, and documentation.
Add bounded retry behavior for transient provider failures with tests.
Explain how the existing usage manager ranks models without modifying files.
Review the authentication module for concrete correctness issues; do not edit it.
Investigate why one deterministic unit test fails on Windows and report the cause.
Write an implementation plan for adding pagination to the existing list API.
Identify missing boundary tests for the date parser and add the two highest-value cases.
Add export support to the dashboard.
Connect the service to our analytics provider.
Add a complete README example for the existing model recommendation command.
Add an optional displayName field while preserving existing serialized data.
Profile the slow list operation, implement the localized bottleneck fix, and verify it.
Plan and execute a compatibility-sensitive architecture migration.
Migrate persisted settings to schema v3 with rollback and legacy-reader compatibility.
Redesign authorization boundaries across the CLI, MCP tools, and delegated agents.
Replace the subprocess protocol without breaking existing host integrations.
Audit the repository for privilege-escalation paths and propose verified remediations.
Refactor run scheduling to support cancellation and fairness across multiple agent queues.
Move the append-only usage ledger to SQLite while preserving all reports and rollback safety.
Make the package run on Node, Bun, and Deno without changing its public API.
Rewrite the platform so it scales globally.
Make every integration zero-trust and compliant.
